overview:
At Rosewood Academy, a prestigious elite school where power is everything, Andrea Riley — a brilliant but underprivileged scholarship student — enters with one goal: uncover the truth behind her sister's mysterious disappearance. But Rosewood plays by its own rules, governed by a dangerous card game that controls the social hierarchy. When Andrea is unexpectedly chosen as the new Queen of Hearts, she becomes entangled with Nathaniel Sinclair, the ruthless and magnetic King of Hearts.

What starts as a strategic move quickly turns into a battle of secrets, power, and forbidden attraction. As Andrea navigates twisted mind games, hidden agendas, and a haunting past, she must decide: play the game and lose herself — or destroy it before it destroys her.

A dark romance filled with suspense, betrayal, and high-stakes drama — where every card turned reveals a deeper lie.
title: Queen of Hearts
